items.html: The answer is that these two coronets are not in ZA as they are, without clothing; but first they were clothed in the Mochin of Aba and Ima, and being clothed there they descended below. But his Hochma and Bina are actual drops that descended from those two segments called the inheritance of Aba and Ima, which are higher. And certainly these higher ones illuminate more than those two coronets, since they descended clothed, even though those very ones descended and not only drops.
